'''Pharples''' were small, flightless [[Bird/Legends|birds]] with long beaks native to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. These cowardly insectivores caused little trouble to [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.<ref name="SWG:P" /> Breeds of pharple included giant pharples and runty pharples.<ref name="SWG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] tamed a giant pharple that they named [[Nym's Girlfriend]] as a means by which to humiliate their enemy [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. The creature was later killed in the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Grenz Zittoun]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref name="SWG:EB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Embarrassing Breakup|Lok}}</ref>
